about.title: About us
about.paragraph1: At Kod & Design we help you realise your digital vision – whether it's a simple website, an advanced web application or a complete system with backend and database. We listen to your needs and deliver a solution tailored specifically to you and your business.
about.paragraph2: From idea to finished product, we handle the entire process. We build with modern technologies such as React, Next.js, TypeScript, Node.js and PostgreSQL – but what matters most to us is that the end result works flawlessly, looks professional and is easy to use for your visitors or customers.
about.paragraph3: Beyond web development, we offer graphic design – logos, business cards, print layouts and visual profiles. We take a holistic approach to your visual identity and ensure that your digital presence and your brand are aligned, from the first sketch to the finished design material.
about.josefine_role: Full-stack Developer & Graphic Designer with a focus on frontend
about.josefine_bio: Josefine has a broad background in full-stack web development with a special focus on frontend and graphic design. With experience in React, Next.js, TypeScript and Node.js she creates visually appealing and functional websites.
about.niklas_role: Full-stack Developer with a focus on backend
about.niklas_bio: Niklas is a versatile full-stack developer with particular strength in backend. With deep knowledge of databases, API development and server logic, he ensures the systems behind the scenes are robust, scalable and efficient.
about.tobias_bio: Tobias is a well-rounded full-stack developer who moves smoothly between frontend and backend. With broad technical skills he contributes solutions across the entire stack – from user interfaces to database management.

services.title: Our services
services.web_desc: Full-stack web applications with modern frameworks such as React, Next.js and Node.js with responsive design.
services.responsive_desc: Mobile-friendly, responsive websites that look perfect on all devices using Tailwind CSS and modern CSS techniques.
services.backend_desc: Robust backend systems with PostgreSQL, Prisma, Server Actions and API development for scalable applications.
services.graphic_desc: Design of logos, business cards, brochures and posters – print-ready originals as well as graphics for social media such as Instagram and Facebook.
